q: 2026 में रक्षा मंत्री की अध्यक्षता वाली रक्षा अधिग्रहण परिषद (DAC) ने लगभग कितनी राशि के रक्षा खरीद प्रस्तावों को आवश्यकता की स्वीकृति (AoN) प्रदान की?
e: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) approved capital acquisition proposals worth approximately ₹2.12 lakh crore in 2026 to bolster indigenous defence capabilities (DAC ने लगभग ₹2.12 लाख करोड़ के रक्षा खरीद प्रस्तावों को मंजूरी दी). Exam Boosters: (1) DAC is the highest decision-making body in the Ministry of Defence for capital acquisitions, set up in 2001 on the GoM recommendations after the Kargil Review Committee; (2) Buy (Indian-IDDM) is the highest priority procurement category under DAP 2020; (3) India's Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) heads the Department of Military Affairs (DMA); (4) DRDO was established in 1958.
qe: In 2026, the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by the Defence Minister, accorded Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) to defence procurement proposals worth approximately:

q: 2026 में प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना – शहरी 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) के अंतर्गत लगभग कितने अतिरिक्त किफायती शहरी आवासों के निर्माण को मंजूरी दी गई?
e: Under PMAY-Urban 2.0 in 2026, 1.93 lakh additional urban houses were approved to expand affordable housing for EWS, LIG, and MIG families (PMAY-शहरी 2.0 के अंतर्गत 1.93 लाख आवासों को मंजूरी दी गई). Exam Boosters: (1) PMAY-U 2.0 (implemented by Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs — MoHUA) targets 1 crore urban poor/middle-class families over 5 years; (2) Its 4 verticals are Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC), Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP), Affordable Rental Housing (ARH), and Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS); (3) PMAY-Gramin is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.
qe: Under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) in 2026, approval was granted for constructing approximately how many additional affordable urban houses?

q: कम लागत वाले और आपदा-रोधी ग्रामीण आवास निर्माण को गति देने के लिए 2026 में किस भारतीय राज्य में '3D-प्रिंटेड ग्रामीण आवास' पहल की शुरुआत की गई?
e: Andhra Pradesh launched/piloted the 3D-Printed Rural Housing initiative in 2026 using additive construction technology for faster, cost-effective rural homes (आंध्र प्रदेश में 3D-प्रिंटेड ग्रामीण आवास पहल शुरू की गई). Exam Boosters: (1) India's first 3D-printed post office was inaugurated in Bengaluru (2023) using L&T and IIT Madras technology; (2) 3D concrete printing reduces construction time and material waste significantly; (3) Andhra Pradesh has the second-longest coastline in India (~974 km) after Gujarat.
qe: Which Indian state piloted the innovative '3D-Printed Rural Housing' initiative in 2026 to accelerate low-cost, disaster-resilient rural home construction?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में जारी उद्योगों के वार्षिक सर्वेक्षण (ASI) 2024–25 की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, भारत के संगठित विनिर्माण क्षेत्र के उत्पादन में कितनी वृद्धि दर्ज की गई?
e: ASI 2024–25 (released Oct 2026 by NSO, MoSPI) recorded a 7.81% growth in India's manufacturing output (ASI 2024–25 में विनिर्माण उत्पादन में 7.81% वृद्धि दर्ज की गई). Exam Boosters: (1) ASI covers factories registered under the Factories Act, 1948; (2) Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme covers 14 key manufacturing sectors to boost domestic production; (3) Make in India was launched on 25 September 2014.
qe: As per the Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) 2024–25 report released in October 2026, India's organized manufacturing sector output recorded a growth of:

q:
ग्रीन एनर्जी कॉरिडोर के चरण III (अक्टूबर 2026 में स्वीकृत) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: यह बड़े पैमाने पर सौर और पवन ऊर्जा को राष्ट्रीय ग्रिड से जोड़ने हेतु समर्पित विद्युत पारेषण लाइनों के निर्माण पर केंद्रित है।
कथन II: इसे बिना किसी घरेलू बजटीय सहायता के केवल विदेशी संप्रभु ऋणों द्वारा वित्तपोषित किया जाता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct. Statement II is incorrect because the Green Energy Corridor scheme receives Central Financial Assistance (CFA) from the Government of India alongside state/utility equity and multilateral loans (कथन I सही है, कथन II गलत है क्योंकि इसमें केंद्र सरकार की वित्तीय सहायता शामिल होती है).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Phase III of the Green Energy Corridor (approved in October 2026):
Statement I: It focuses on building dedicated power transmission lines to integrate large-scale solar and wind power into the national grid.
Statement II: It is funded exclusively through foreign sovereign loans without any domestic budgetary support.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: प्री-COP31 जलवायु मंत्रिस्तरीय बैठक (अक्टूबर 2026) में भारत ने पेरिस समझौते के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता दोहराई। विकासशील देशों के लिए जलवायु न्याय सुनिश्चित करने हेतु भारत ने UNFCCC के किस मूल सिद्धांत पर बल दिया?
o: Common But Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities (CBDR-RC)
Uniform Equal Emission Cuts for all nations
e: India consistently emphasizes Equity and Common But Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities (CBDR-RC) under UNFCCC and the Paris Agreement (साझा किंतु विभेदित उत्तरदायित्व और संबंधित क्षमताएँ — CBDR-RC). Exam Boosters: (1) Paris Agreement aims to hold global warming well below 2°C and pursue 1.5°C; (2) COP21 (2015, Paris) adopted the Paris Agreement; (3) India updated its NDC to cut GDP emissions intensity by 45% by 2030 (over 2005 levels).
qe: At the Pre-COP31 climate ministerial meeting (October 2026), India reiterated its commitment to the Paris Agreement. Which core UNFCCC principle did India emphasize to ensure climate justice for developing nations?
oe: Common But Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities (CBDR-RC)
Uniform Equal Emission Cuts for all nations

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा नगर गोमती नदी के तट पर स्थित है और राज्य की प्रशासनिक राजधानी है?
e: Lucknow (capital of UP) lies on the banks of the Gomti River (लखनऊ गोमती नदी के तट पर स्थित है). Exam Boosters: (1) Ayodhya is on the Saryu (Ghaghra) River; (2) Varanasi and Kanpur are on the Ganga; (3) Agra and Mathura are on the Yamuna; (4) Gorakhpur is on the Rapti River.
qe: Which city in Uttar Pradesh is situated on the banks of the Gomti River and serves as the state's administrative capital?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा जिला पूरे देश में 'भारत की इत्र राजधानी' (इत्र नगरी) के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Kannauj (ancient Kanyakubja, capital of Harshavardhana) is famous for traditional Attar (perfume) manufacturing (कन्नौज को इत्र नगरी कहा जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Aligarh — Locks & Hardware; (2) Saharanpur — Wood Carving; (3) Meerut — Sports Goods; (4) Mirzapur & Bhadohi — Carpets.
qe: Which district of Uttar Pradesh is famous nationwide as the 'Perfume Capital of India' (Itra Nagari)?

q: बिना किसी खंभे के विशाल केंद्रीय कक्ष और भूलभुलैया के लिए प्रसिद्ध लखनऊ के 'बड़ा इमामबाड़ा' का निर्माण किसने करवाया था?
e: Nawab Asaf-ud-Daulah built Bara Imambara in 1784 as a famine relief project (architect: Kifayatullah) (नवाब आसफ-उद-दौला ने 1784 में बड़ा इमामबाड़ा बनवाया). Exam Boosters: (1) Asaf-ud-Daulah shifted the capital of Awadh from Faizabad to Lucknow in 1775; (2) Chota Imambara was built by Muhammad Ali Shah (1838); (3) Rumi Darwaza in Lucknow was also built by Asaf-ud-Daulah.
qe: The 'Bara Imambara' (Asafi Imambara), renowned for its central hall without any supporting beams and the Bhool Bhulaiya labyrinth, was constructed in Lucknow by:

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा वन्यजीव अभयारण्य राज्य का सबसे पुराना वन्यजीव अभयारण्य है, जिसकी स्थापना 1957 में चंदौली जिले में हुई थी?
e: Chandraprabha Wildlife Sanctuary (Chandauli district, est. 1957) is UP's oldest wildlife sanctuary, famous for Rajdari and Devdari waterfalls (चंद्रप्रभा वन्यजीव अभयारण्य, 1957, चंदौली). Exam Boosters: (1) Hastinapur Wildlife Sanctuary is UP's largest wildlife sanctuary by area; (2) Mahavir Swami Wildlife Sanctuary (Lalitpur) is UP's smallest; (3) Nawabganj Bird Sanctuary (Unnao, renamed Chandra Shekhar Azad Bird Sanctuary) is UP's oldest bird sanctuary (1984).
qe: Which wildlife sanctuary in Uttar Pradesh is the oldest wildlife sanctuary in the state, established in 1957 in Chandauli district?

q: निम्नलिखित में से उत्तर प्रदेश के अनुसंधान संस्थानों और उनके स्थान का कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR) — Kanpur
Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR) — Varanasi
e: Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR) is located in LUCKNOW, whereas the National Sugar Institute (NSI) and Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR) are located in Kanpur (भारतीय गन्ना अनुसंधान संस्थान लखनऊ में स्थित है, कानपुर में नहीं). Exam Boosters: (1) National Botanical Research Institute (NBRI) and Central Institute of Medicinal and Aromatic Plants (CIMAP) are also in Lucknow; (2) Central Institute for Research on Goats (CIRG) is at Makhdoom (Mathura).
qe: Which of the following pairs of Uttar Pradesh research institutes and their locations is NOT correctly matched?
oe: Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR) — Kanpur
Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR) — Varanasi

q: प्रसिद्ध कांस्य 'नर्तकी की मूर्ति' (Dancing Girl) सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के किस प्रमुख स्थल से उत्खनन में प्राप्त हुई थी?
e: The 10.5 cm bronze 'Dancing Girl' (made by lost-wax / cire-perdue technique) was excavated from Mohenjo-daro (मोहेनजोदड़ो से कांस्य नर्तकी की मूर्ति प्राप्त हुई). Exam Boosters: (1) Mohenjo-daro (Sindh, Indus River) was excavated by R. D. Banerji in 1922; (2) Harappa (Ravi River) was excavated by Daya Ram Sahni in 1921; (3) Great Bath, Great Granary, and Pashupati Seal were also found at Mohenjo-daro.
qe: The famous bronze statue of the 'Dancing Girl' was excavated from which major Indus Valley Civilization site?

q: 1206 ई. में दिल्ली सल्तनत के गुलाम (मामलूक) वंश का संस्थापक कौन था, जिसे 'लाख बख्श' (लाखों का दान देने वाला) कहा जाता था?
e: Qutb-ud-din Aibak founded the Delhi Sultanate in 1206 with Lahore as capital; he started the construction of Qutub Minar and built Quwwat-ul-Islam Mosque and Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra (कुतुबुद्दीन ऐबक को लाख बख्श कहा जाता था). Exam Boosters: (1) Aibak died in 1210 while playing Chaugan (polo); (2) Iltutmish shifted capital to Delhi and organized the 'Turkan-i-Chahalgani' (Corps of Forty); (3) Razia Sultan (1236–1240) was the first and only female ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.
qe: Who was the founder of the Slave (Mamluk) Dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate in 1206 CE, known as 'Lakh Baksh' (giver of lakhs)?

q: 1828 में 'ब्रह्म समाज' की स्थापना किसने की और लॉर्ड विलियम बेंटिंक के समय 1829 में सती प्रथा के उन्मूलन में प्रमुख भूमिका निभाई?
e: Raja Ram Mohan Roy ('Father of Indian Renaissance') founded Atmiya Sabha (1815) and Brahmo Samaj (1828), campaigning relentlessly for Bengal Sati Regulation XVII of 1829 (राजा राममोहन राय ने 1828 में ब्रह्म समाज की स्थापना की). Exam Boosters: (1) Mughal Emperor Akbar II conferred the title 'Raja' on him; (2) He published 'Sambad Kaumudi' (Bengali) and 'Mirat-ul-Akbar' (Persian); (3) Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar championed the Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act of 1856.
qe: Who founded the 'Brahmo Samaj' in 1828 and played a pivotal role in the abolition of Sati in 1829 under Lord William Bentinck?

q:
भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन की निम्नलिखित घटनाओं को उनके सही वर्षों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. गांधी-इरविन समझौता — (a) 1919
2. रॉलेट एक्ट — (b) 1931
3. कैबिनेट मिशन योजना — (c) 1942
4. क्रिप्स मिशन — (d) 1946
e: Gandhi-Irwin Pact = March 1931; Rowlatt Act = March 1919 ('Black Act'); Cabinet Mission = March 1946 (Pethick-Lawrence, Stafford Cripps, A. V. Alexander); Cripps Mission = March 1942. Correct match: 1-b, 2-a, 3-d, 4-c (सही मिलान 1-b, 2-a, 3-d, 4-c है).
qe:
Match the following events of the Indian National Movement with their correct years:
1. Gandhi-Irwin Pact — (a) 1919
2. Rowlatt Act — (b) 1931
3. Cabinet Mission Plan — (c) 1942
4. Cripps Mission — (d) 1946

q: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के 1924 के बेलगाम अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी — जो उनके द्वारा अध्यक्षता किया गया एकमात्र कांग्रेस अधिवेशन था?
e: Mahatma Gandhi presided over the INC only once — at the 1924 Belgaum (Karnataka) Session (महात्मा गांधी ने केवल 1924 के बेलगाम अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता की थी). Exam Boosters: (1) First woman President of INC: Annie Besant (1917, Calcutta); (2) First Indian woman President of INC: Sarojini Naidu (1925, Kanpur); (3) Sardar Patel presided over the 1931 Karachi Session (Fundamental Rights resolution); (4) Maulana Azad was the youngest INC President (1923) and longest-serving pre-independence President (1940–46).
qe: Who presided over the 1924 Belgaum Session of the Indian National Congress — the ONLY INC session ever presided over by him?

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत 'अस्पृश्यता' का अंत किया गया है और किसी भी रूप में इसका आचरण निषिद्ध है?
e: Article 17 (Right to Equality) abolishes untouchability absolutely (अनुच्छेद 17 अस्पृश्यता का उन्मूलन करता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Article 15 prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth; (2) Article 16 ensures equality of opportunity in public employment; (3) Article 18 abolishes titles (except military and academic distinctions); (4) Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 enforces Article 17.
qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is 'Untouchability' abolished and its practice in any form forbidden?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा लोकसभा और राज्य विधानसभा चुनावों में मतदान की न्यूनतम आयु 21 वर्ष से घटाकर 18 वर्ष कर दी गई?
e: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 (effective 28 March 1989) amended Article 326 to lower the voting age from 21 to 18 years (61वें संविधान संशोधन द्वारा मतदान आयु 21 से 18 वर्ष की गई). Exam Boosters: (1) 44th Amendment (1978) replaced 'internal disturbance' with 'armed rebellion' for National Emergency; (2) 73rd Amendment (1992) gave constitutional status to Panchayats; (3) 74th Amendment (1992) gave constitutional status to Urban Local Bodies (Municipalities).
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act reduced the minimum voting age in Lok Sabha and State Assembly elections from 21 years to 18 years?

q: स्कूली पाठ्यक्रम, पाठ्यपुस्तकों और शैक्षिक अनुसंधान पर केंद्र तथा राज्य सरकारों को सलाह देने हेतु 1961 में एक स्वायत्त संगठन के रूप में किस शैक्षिक निकाय की स्थापना की गई थी?
e: NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training, New Delhi) was established in September 1961 (एनसीईआरटी की स्थापना 1961 में हुई थी). Exam Boosters: (1) NCERT prepares the National Curriculum Framework (NCF — latest NCF-SE 2023 under NEP 2020); (2) PARAKH (National Assessment Centre) has been set up within NCERT under NEP 2020; (3) SCERT performs equivalent functions at the state level (SCERT UP is in Lucknow).
qe: Which educational body was established in 1961 as an autonomous organization to advise Central and State Governments on school curriculum, textbooks, and educational research?

q:
भारतीय संसद के दोनों सदनों की संयुक्त बैठक (अनुच्छेद 108) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: संयुक्त बैठक भारत के राष्ट्रपति द्वारा साधारण विधेयक पर गतिरोध दूर करने हेतु बुलाई जाती है, किंतु धन विधेयक या संविधान संशोधन विधेयक पर नहीं।
कथन II: संयुक्त बैठक की अध्यक्षता भारत के उपराष्ट्रपति (राज्यसभा के सभापति) करते हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct. Statement II is incorrect because under Article 118(4), a Joint Sitting is presided over by the SPEAKER of Lok Sabha (and in Speaker's absence, Deputy Speaker of Lok Sabha, then Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha — NEVER the Vice-President) (संयुक्त बैठक की अध्यक्षता लोकसभा अध्यक्ष करते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Joint sitting has been invoked only 3 times in India: Dowry Prohibition Bill (1961), Banking Service Commission Repeal Bill (1978), and POTA Bill (2002).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Joint Sitting of both Houses of Indian Parliament (Article 108):
Statement I: A Joint Sitting is summoned by the President of India to resolve a deadlock on an Ordinary Bill or Financial Bill, but NOT on a Money Bill or Constitutional Amendment Bill.
Statement II: The Joint Sitting is presided over by the Vice-President of India (Chairman of Rajya Sabha).
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: राज्य के नीति निदेशक तत्वों (DPSP) का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद राज्य को अनुसूचित जातियों, अनुसूचित जनजातियों और अन्य दुर्बल वर्गों के शिक्षा व अर्थ संबंधी हितों की अभिवृद्धि का निर्देश देता है?
e: Article 46 directs the State to promote with special care the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections, in particular SCs and STs, and protect them from social injustice (अनुच्छेद 46 SC/ST व दुर्बल वर्गों के शैक्षिक-आर्थिक हितों से संबंधित है). Exam Boosters: (1) Article 44: Uniform Civil Code; (2) Article 45: Early childhood care and education below age 6; (3) Article 48A (added by 42nd Amendment): Protection of environment, forests, and wildlife.
qe: Which Directive Principle of State Policy (DPSP) directs the State to promote the educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and other weaker sections?

q: जम्मू-कश्मीर में कौन-सा पर्वतीय दर्रा वृहत हिमालय के पार श्रीनगर को लेह (लद्दाख) से जोड़ता है?
e: Zoji La (altitude ~3,528 m) connects Srinagar to Kargil and Leh (ज़ोजिला दर्रा श्रीनगर को लेह से जोड़ता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Shipki La (Himachal Pradesh) — Sutlej enters India; (2) Nathu La & Jelep La — Sikkim; (3) Lipulekh & Mana Pass — Uttarakhand; (4) Banihal Pass (Jawahar Tunnel) connects Jammu to Srinagar.
qe: Which mountain pass in Jammu & Kashmir connects Srinagar to Leh (Ladakh) across the Great Himalayas?

q: भारत के लगभग 40% भौगोलिक क्षेत्र को आच्छादित करने वाली 'जलोढ़ मृदा' को पुरानी जलोढ़ और नई उपजाऊ जलोढ़ के रूप में क्रमशः क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Older alluvium (containing calcareous 'kankar' nodules) is called Bangar (बांगर), while newer, annually replenished flood-plain alluvium is called Khadar (खादर) (पुरानी जलोढ़ = बांगर, नई जलोढ़ = खादर). Exam Boosters: (1) Alluvial soil is rich in Potash and Lime but poor in Nitrogen and Phosphorus; (2) Bhabar is the coarse pebble-studded foothill belt where streams disappear, re-emerging in the marshy Terai belt.
qe: 'Alluvial Soil' (जलोढ़ मृदा), covering nearly 40% of India's geographical area, is divided into older alluvium and newer fertile alluvium called respectively:

q: भारत वन स्थिति रिपोर्ट (ISFR) के अनुसार, किस भारतीय राज्य में उसके कुल भौगोलिक क्षेत्रफल के प्रतिशत की दृष्टि से सर्वाधिक वनावरण (~85% से अधिक) है?
e: Mizoram has the highest percentage of forest cover relative to its total geographical area (>84%), whereas Madhya Pradesh has the largest forest cover by absolute area (प्रतिशत में सर्वाधिक वनावरण मिजोरम में तथा क्षेत्रफल में सर्वाधिक मध्य प्रदेश में है). Exam Boosters: (1) ISFR is published biennially by the Forest Survey of India (FSI, Dehradun); (2) National Forest Policy (1988) targets 33% of India's geographical area under forest/tree cover.
qe: Which Indian state has the highest proportion of its geographical area under forest cover (percentage-wise, ~85%+) according to the India State of Forest Report (ISFR)?

q: भारत में किस संस्था को 'बैंकों का बैंक' और 'अंतिम ऋणदाता' (Lender of Last Resort) कहा जाता है?
e: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI), India's central bank (est. 1 April 1935), acts as Banker to the Government, Banker's Bank, and Lender of Last Resort (भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक को बैंकों का बैंक कहा जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) RBI issues all currency notes except ₹1 note and coins (which are issued by the Ministry of Finance and signed by the Finance Secretary); (2) RBI's headquarters shifted from Calcutta to Mumbai in 1937.
qe: Which institution is known as the 'Banker's Bank' and 'Lender of Last Resort' in India?

q: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में 'स्टैगफ्लेशन' (Stagflation) किस चुनौतीपूर्ण आर्थिक स्थिति को दर्शाता है?
o: High economic growth combined with falling prices
Continuous fall in prices (deflation) alongside high GDP growth
Rapid industrial expansion with zero unemployment
Stagnant economic growth and high unemployment combined with high inflation
e: Stagflation = Stagnation (low/zero growth + high unemployment) + Inflation (persistently rising prices) (मंदी/उच्च बेरोजगारी के साथ उच्च मुद्रास्फीति की स्थिति). Exam Boosters: (1) Phillips Curve normally shows an inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment, which breaks down during stagflation; (2) Deflation is a sustained fall in the general price level; (3) Disinflation is a slowing down of the rate of inflation.
qe: 'Stagflation' in macroeconomics refers to a challenging economic situation characterized by:
oe: High economic growth combined with falling prices
Continuous fall in prices (deflation) alongside high GDP growth
Rapid industrial expansion with zero unemployment
Stagnant economic growth and high unemployment combined with high inflation

q: निम्नलिखित में से किसे किसी देश के सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) की गणना में शामिल नहीं किया जाता है?
o: Market value of newly manufactured automobiles
Salaries paid to government school teachers
Old-age pensions and unemployment transfer payments
e: Transfer payments (pensions, scholarships, subsidies) do NOT correspond to current production of goods or services, so they are excluded from GDP (हस्तांतरण भुगतान जैसे पेंशन GDP में शामिल नहीं होते). Exam Boosters: (1) Sale of second-hand goods and intermediate goods are also excluded to avoid double counting; (2) GNP = GDP + Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA); (3) NNP at Factor Cost = National Income.
qe: Which of the following is NOT included in the calculation of a country's Gross Domestic Product (GDP)?
oe: Market value of newly manufactured automobiles
Salaries paid to government school teachers
Old-age pensions and unemployment transfer payments

q: टंगस्टन फिलामेंट के ऑक्सीकरण को रोकने के लिए आधुनिक विद्युत बल्बों में नाइट्रोजन के साथ मुख्य रूप से कौन-सी निष्क्रिय गैस भरी जाती है?
e: Inert gas Argon (Ar) (often mixed with Nitrogen) is filled inside incandescent bulbs to prevent evaporation and oxidation of the tungsten filament (बल्ब में आर्गन गैस भरी जाती है). Exam Boosters: (1) Tungsten (W) has an extremely high melting point (~3,422°C); (2) Helium is used in weather balloons and deep-sea diving cylinders; (3) Neon is used in luminous advertising signboards; (4) LED stands for Light Emitting Diode.
qe: Which gas is primarily filled inside modern electric bulbs (incandescent lamps) alongside nitrogen to prevent oxidation of the tungsten filament?

q: संक्रमित मादा एडीज इजिप्टी मच्छर के काटने से निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा रोग होता है?
e: Female Aedes aegypti mosquito transmits viral diseases including Dengue, Chikungunya, Zika, and Yellow Fever (मादा एडीज मच्छर से डेंगू और चिकनगुनिया होता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Malaria (Plasmodium protozoa) is transmitted by female Anopheles mosquito; (2) Kala-azar (Leishmania) is spread by Sandfly; (3) Sleeping sickness (Trypanosoma) by Tsetse fly; (4) Filariasis (Elephantiasis) by Culex mosquito.
qe: Which disease is caused by the bite of an infected female Aedes aegypti mosquito?

q: कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर में सेंट्रल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट (CPU) का कौन-सा घटक सभी गणितीय गणनाएँ और तार्किक तुलनाएँ करता है?
e: The Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) inside the CPU executes arithmetic operations (+, −, ×, ÷) and logical operations (AND, OR, NOT, comparisons) (ALU सभी गणितीय व तार्किक गणनाएँ करता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Control Unit (CU) coordinates instruction fetch-decode-execute cycles; (2) Registers are the fastest memory inside the CPU; (3) 1 Byte = 8 Bits, 1 Kilobyte (KB) = 1,024 Bytes; (4) Charles Babbage is the 'Father of Computer'.
qe: In computer architecture, which component of the Central Processing Unit (CPU) performs all mathematical calculations and logical comparisons?
